rejectionRules: Reject any file without a stable public source URL, byte count and format.
Reject any file without a source-metadata checksum with its declared algorithm; SHA-1 is source evidence, not a substitute for later local SHA-256.
Reject any non-null local SHA-256 because this preflight does not acquire a file.
Reject any file without a recorded file-level rights decision.
Reject a coordinate field only when it has an explicit missing reason; missingness never grants registration.
Reject any manifest that asserts downloaded, bundled or registered status.
